269311cc05.q: How should real estate investors build the business before buying properties?
269311cc05.a: Build the entire business first by hiring experts such as property managers, contractors, plumbers, roofers, inspectors, and mortgage workers before purchasing any real estate. Contact property managers in advance to determine rental rates, vacancy factors, and whether they will manage the property. Calculate all expenses including mortgage, taxes, insurance, vacancy factor, and repairs to determine required rental income, then only purchase if the property meets your cash flow target.
269311cc05.e: Build the Business BEFORE You Buy Real Estate

60b71a8981.q: Why did Dustin Heiner leave his government job despite having job security?
